articles.title: Kraken's xStocks adds 200 UK and EU shares as its assets top $1.1 billion
articles.snippet: Payward says xStocks holds over $1.1 billion. Each token is backed by a share but gives no ownership of the underlying company.

articles.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
articles.snippet: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

articles.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
articles.snippet: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
articles.snippet: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

articles.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
articles.snippet: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.
